description:
Price movements at one supermarket between the latest nightly
    snapshot and the previous one: shelf price rises and falls with old price,
    new price and % change, and promotions starting or ending listed
    separately (an offer ending is not a price rise).

    Args:
        store: "aldi" | "tesco" | "supervalu" | "dunnes" | "lidl".
        limit: how many movers to return (default 25).
name: recent_price_changes

outputSchema.description:
The /changes payload.

Shelf moves, promotions and loyalty-card changes are deliberately SEPARATE
buckets, not one blended list: an expiring offer is not a price rise, and
merging them turns a price report into a promotions calendar.

clubcard_changes.description: Member price changes: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_changes.title: Clubcard Changes

promotions.description: Offers starting or ending, not shelf moves
promotions.title: Promotions

outputSchema.title: PriceChanges

title: Recent price changes
